# lacapillaoscura.es

**La Capilla Oscura (LCO) · Horario de misas**: conciertos de rock, metal y cultura oscura en Madrid, día a día.

This repository is the published static website served by GitHub Pages at https://lacapillaoscura.es (`CNAME`).

**Generated by La Capilla Oscura's weekly prep — don't edit by hand.** Every file here is overwritten by the next build:

- `index.html`: the weekly agenda ("Horario de misas"), next weeks, month view (Calendario litúrgico), filters
- `agenda.json`: public event data (confirmed events only; prices are approximate)
- `agenda.ics` / `ics/*.ics`: calendar files
- `aviso-legal.html`, `404.html`, `assets/` (self-hosted fonts under the SIL Open Font License, CSS, JS, images)

No cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests. Contact: info@lacapillaoscura.es · Instagram [@lacapillaoscura](https://www.instagram.com/lacapillaoscura/)
